== Summary ==
Complete printed 7 side of the Players Committee Virtual Set 1 objective with E errata mark, cropped from page 15 (right column, wide central panel) of the archived Master List. It preserves the card border and original host-card caption. The omnibus PDF records 3 August 2016 production and modification and was captured on 6 August 2016.

== Source ==
* [https://web.archive.org/web/20160806222826id_/http://www.starwarsccg.org/virtual/MasterList.pdf#page=15 Players Committee Master List, archival copy], page 15.

archive.org copy of this exact original (SHA-1 checked by archive.org): [https://archive.org/download/swccg-wiki-images-2/2f/PC-Set1-No-One-To-Stop-Us-This-Time-August-2016-E-back.png Internet Archive item].
